<Heading as={"h1"} className={"openapi__heading"}>
  {"Get the status of the restore that is currently in progress"}{" "}
  <MarkerAddedInVersion version="8.10" />{" "}
  <MarkerScope scope="physical-tenant" />
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/restore"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

<MarkerStronglyConsistentExtension />

Returns the status of the restore that is currently in progress, reported per broker and per partition. There is at most one restore in flight at any time. Once the restore has finished this endpoint returns 404; the per-partition detail is not retained after completion.

<MarkerRequiredPermissions
  permissions={[{ resourceType: "BACKUP", permissionType: "RESTORE" }]}
/>

<ParamsDetails parameters={undefined}></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema title={"Body"} body={undefined}></RequestSchema>

    "200": {
      description: "The status of the restore that is currently in progress.",
      content: {
        "application/json": {
          schema: {
            description:
              "The status of the restore that is currently in progress.",
            type: "object",
            required: ["status", "changeId", "startedAt", "brokers"],
            properties: {
              status: {
                description: "The overall status of the restore.",
                type: "string",
                enum: ["IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"],

              changeId: {
                description:

                type: "string",

              },
              startedAt: {
                description:
                  "The time the restore started, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.",

                nullable: true,

              },
              brokers: {

                  properties: {

                      description:

                      type: "string",

                      description:

                      type: "integer",
                      format: "int32",
                      example: 1,
                    },
                    partitionsToRestore: {

                      type: "integer",

                      example: 3,
                    },
                    partitions: {
                      description:
                        "The per-partition restore status for this broker.",
                      type: "array",
                      items: {
                        description:

                        type: "object",
                        required: [

                            format: "date-time",

                            example: "2024-01-01T10:02:00Z",
